rounds.title: PBE5AC_PURE_SYMMETRIC_ATPC_24_NO_SWR_CAP
rounds.hypothesis: Isolating /proc/sys/dev/uph_wifi0/atpc='1 -62 24 24 24' (symmetric 24/24 dBm lock neutralizing UPH-BUG-05) without touching swr_limit ('0 0 0') on top of Stage 73A Champion v6 preserves full A-MPDU goodput while preventing ATPC min/max power inversion dips.

followup_scholar_queries: IEEE 802.11v Directed Multicast Service DMS multicast to unicast PtMP video
IGMPv3 fast leave wireless bridge multicast snooping airtime protection

synthesized_next_mechanisms.title: PB-037 Stock airOS 8 netconf WMM AC_VI EDCA Contention Window & TXOP Tuning (CWmin=7, CWmax=15, AIFSN=2, TXOP=3008us) + ff_mcast_airtime_limit=5 (Written Last)
synthesized_next_mechanisms.scientific_basis: Stage 34A S34A-R1 (+7.244% goodput with ff_mcast_airtime_limit=5) + Stage 35A S35A-R1 Champion v9 (+1.705% goodput, -15.121% p95 RTT) + Stage 39A ubnt_poll_host.ko shared sysctl_table->data buffer clobber guard (write ff_mcast_airtime_limit=5 LAST without voip_bias clobbering it)

rounds.title: PBE5AC_FAST_TURNAROUND_TIMING_200_200_4000
rounds.hypothesis: Preserving fast 200 us DL/UL turnaround slots while tightening burst ceiling from 6000 us to 4000 us (/proc/sys/dev/uph_wifi0/timing='200 200 4000' -> Down:200, Up:200, Burst:4000) on top of Stage 73A Champion v6 reduces loaded p50/p95/p99 RTT without the 10x slot-inflation penalty of 2000 2000 1000.
